prompt: Describe version control branching. NEGATIVE CONSTRAINT 1: Do not use any punctuation marks. NEGATIVE CONSTRAINT 2: Must be written as a single continuous line of text.
evaluation_criteria:
Punctuation Exclusion: 0-5 (Evaluates zero punctuation)
Single Line: 0-5 (Evaluates absence of newlines)
response_text: Version control branching is a process where developers create a copy of the primary code repository to work on features or bug fixes in isolation so they can make changes without affecting the main project until they are ready to combine their work back into the master timeline
